MYP 1 Language and Literature · Unit 2: Beyond Vision

The Director’s Cut

Formative assessment · Criterion A: Analysing · Criterion C: Producing text

First you will analyse how a graphic novel page communicates with its reader. Then you will become the director: you will turn a short story into your own comic panels and explain every choice you make.

TimeWhat you doCriterion
5 minChoose your graphic novel page and read the story.
15 minPart A: add at least 3 annotations to your page.A i, ii, iii
20 minPart B: build 3 comic panels and explain each choice.C i, ii, iii
5 minSave as PDF and upload it to ManageBac.

Your work saves on this device as you go. If the bell rings, come back and carry on.

Part A · Criterion A

Analyse a page

Choose one page from The Fishy Treasure Caper. Tap anywhere on the page to drop a numbered pin, then complete the annotation for that pin. Every annotation needs three things: what you see, the correct term, and the effect on the reader.

Tap the page to add a pin. Tap a pin to jump to its annotation.

0 of 3 annotations complete

No pins yet. Tap the page to add your first annotation.

Part B · Criterion C

Your Director’s Cut

Read The Night Platform, a short original story. Turn it into three comic panels. You decide which moments to show and how to show them.

Step 1: Decide your director’s vision

Step 2: Build your panels

Add a background, characters, props and words. Drag things to move them. Select something to change its size, colour or expression. Use the camera to zoom in for a close up.
